scale: Stockfish UCI_Elo, derived from CCRL calibration

scoreInterval.method: Hoeffding bound on independent bounded color-pair scores, conditional on the selected openings. Calibration and hardware uncertainty excluded.

method: Fit one Elo to the mean expected score across reference settings, weighting games equally. Draws contribute half a point. The two setup pilot games are excluded.
limitation: Small, fixed-opening multi-anchor performance estimate, not a population rating. Stockfish calibration is approximate and engine-specific. Node and browser performance can differ. No FIDE, Chess.com or Lichess claim.
studyDesign: Exploratory: reference settings were added after earlier results. The nominal independence interval does not account for adaptive reference-setting selection.
